title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387992802601 with a grade-14 paid cutoff
body:
The 832-factor schedule uses a paid cutoff of 14^832 and productive floor of 16^832. Two complete finite application checks give conditional κ ≥ **0.00387992802601**, an increase of **9.5 × 10⁻¹³** over #7831. The larger carrier and logarithmic majorant are recorded in the package. The five framework premises are inherited.

The package includes reproducible sources and receipts. CPython 3.12 replayed 12 pinned inputs, 127 inherited sources, both native orientations, 54 strict and four functional outer checks. Lean 4.34.1 checked the rational separation and cutoff comparison. Please review the physical paid subdivision and the use of the ordinary BIT cap by the rational caller.

Submitted by [@RohanArun](https://x.com/RohanArun) on X. [Original submission](https://x.com/RohanArun/status/2123655584797143516). Codex performed the experiment and replay. The package credits the contributors to #7786, #7830 and #7831.
